why: Kill C1 with co-located drive-by Y and real visit occupancy R. Not a T-Drive speed clone. Not GPS overlay on SensorScope/U-Air.
y_aggregation: mean of finite calibrated pm25 inside cell x slot
atomic_unit: 500m_cell x 30min_slot with at least one finite pm25

grid.origin: equirectangular from observed GPS bbox of the NYC PM files; origin uses floor of min lon/lat; no Y
grid.bbox_source: min/max latitude longitude of kept GPS rows, no Y

r_rule: client occupies unit iff that cell has >=1 kept sample in that 30min slot
c1_kill_rule: SCD paired mean relative vs BOTH fedau_window and obsuse_window is <= -0.005 on WorstGroupRMSE OR on RMSE_mu
c1_kill_is_not: descriptive +0.5% tolerance; Holm-nonsignificant 'not worse'; Traffic 4-region protocol ranking; T-Drive spatial block
physical_filters_frozen: drop rows with non-finite latitude, longitude, time, or pm25
do not retune filters after RMSE
ingest_abort_if: Zenodo license cannot be copied from the record page into LICENSE.json
any region of h(i) has zero test units
vehicle ids used as FL clients
